name: Liquidity Credit Transfer 4
definition: Provides details specific to the liquidity credit transfer, used to transfer an amount of money from the debtor to the creditor, where both are financial institutions.

LiquidityTransferIdentification.name: Liquidity Transfer Identification
LiquidityTransferIdentification.definition: Used to uniquely identify the liquidity transfer.

Creditor.name: Creditor
Creditor.definition: Owner of the account to be credited.

CreditorAccount.name: Creditor Account
CreditorAccount.definition: Account to be credited as a result of a transfer of liquidity.

TransferredAmount.name: Transferred Amount
TransferredAmount.definition: Amount of money that the transaction administrator transfers from one account to another.

Debtor.name: Debtor
Debtor.definition: Owner of the account to be debited.

DebtorAccount.name: Debtor Account
DebtorAccount.definition: Account to be debited as a result of a transfer of liquidity.

SettlementDate.name: Settlement Date
SettlementDate.definition: Date on which the amount of money ceases to be available to the agent that owes it and when the amount of money becomes available to the agent to which it is due.

CreditAccountRule.definition: At least CreditAccount or Creditor must be present, or both.
